metadata.title: Vibrant Pop Portrait with Script Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: High-key studio portrait featuring a central subject with a bright accent accessory and a stylized script nameplate overlay in the lower third.
triggerTerms: bright studio portrait with orange bucket hat
script overlay on lower third portrait
excludeWhen: moody or low-light photography is requested
minimalist composition without text is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-key studio portrait of a young woman with a joyful, surprised expression, wearing a bright orange bucket hat. Her hands frame her face, and a stylized, outlined script name is positioned across the lower chest area against a clean white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face as the central focal point
Orange hat echoing the color of the typographic fill
Symmetrical hand placement framing the jawline
Text overlay integrated into the lower foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up, head and shoulders filling the majority of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's open mouth and eyes form the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright orange hat down to the eyes, following the hands to the typographic nameplate at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Pure white background surrounding the subject's head and shoulders.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, high saturation for the orange elements against a neutral white base.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to white, orange, and natural skin/hair tones

letterConstructionRules: Strong white outer stroke for legibility against clothing
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative script for branding focus.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar upright script feel with clear legibility
Casual, friendly script with similar weight

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a young woman with a surprised, happy expression, wearing a bright orange bucket hat and a white ruffled top, hands framing her face, against a pure white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large script name in the lower third using an orange fill, a thick white outline, and a subtle drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the hat a vibrant orange?
Does the text have a visible white outline?
Is the subject's expression joyful and surprised?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean separation between subject and white background
Ensure the orange of the hat and text are harmonious
Verify the script font is legible despite the outline
Confirm the 'surprised' expression looks natural and energetic
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio portrait + [Vibrant Accessory] + [Subject Expression] + [Script Nameplate Overlay]
